meetings.title: 30 Min Meeting between Yusheng Kuo and Chehan Karunaratne
meetings.summary: The team discussed the integration of a research agent and a snippet agent to streamline workflow and improve reliability. By consolidating these agents, tasks can be chained seamlessly, thus reducing fragility associated with separate agents. They emphasized the use of Cloud Code for managing the combined agent and addressed challenges in scaling such agents for parallel processing. A dedicated validation agent was proposed to ensure signal accuracy, while hands-on learning was encouraged for skill development.

meetings.summary: The meeting centered on the setup and integration of various Cloud Code tools aimed at automating research workflows. Key tasks included the installation of Data Gen CLI and MCP agents for efficient automation and secure deployments, along with GitHub CLI for streamlined repository management. The team explored solutions for managing large markdown outputs, specifically addressing Clay's size limits by proposing the use of scalable cloud storage like S3. Additionally, webhook integration with Clay for effective data flow and the impact of model selection on research execution speed were significant discussion points.
